purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: GLUE
candidates.notes: 9 NLU tasks (MNLI, QQP, QNLI, SST-2, CoLA, STS-B, MRPC, RTE, WNLI) with train splits + label outputs.

candidates.name: SuperGLUE
candidates.notes: Includes BoolQ, CB, COPA, MultiRC, ReCoRD, RTE, WiC, WSC. Mostly labeled classification/NLI targets.

candidates.name: CoNLL-2003 (NER)
candidates.notes: Classic NER + POS + chunking data (English/German). Token-level labels => structured answer form.

candidates.name: Universal Dependencies
candidates.notes: Treebanks for 150+ languages incl. many low-resource ones. Excellent low-resource language coverage; per-treebank licenses vary (must audit individually).

candidates.name: Language Identification (papluca)
candidates.notes: 20-language identification corpus from Wikipedia/Tatoeba. Direct 20-class label target; provenance = community aggregation.

candidates.name: MASSIVE Intent (MTEB port)
candidates.notes: MTEB re-packaging of MASSIVE for evaluation. Duplicate risk vs AmazonScience/massive.
